evals.prompt: I need to add a shortcode with parameters that wraps enclosed content to a WordPress plugin in our repo. Where in our local docs should I read up on this before I write it?
evals.expected_output: Should point to the shortcodes section of the local Plugin Handbook mirror, docs/wordpress/wordpress-plugins/08-shortcodes/, rather than citing memory or the public site.
assertions: Directs the user to the local mirror under docs/wordpress/wordpress-plugins/
Does not rely only on memory or the public website

evals.prompt: I'm about to add a new custom database table to a plugin and need to handle schema versioning for later updates. Which page of our local WordPress docs mirror should I check first?
evals.expected_output: Should point to docs/wordpress/wordpress-plugins/21-creating-tables-with-plugins/ and mention dbDelta().

evals.prompt: I want to check the exact arguments and response fields of the core REST API users endpoint. Where is that documented in our local docs?
evals.expected_output: Should point to the REST API reference mirror, docs/wordpress/api-reference/wordpress-rest-apis/06-reference/ (the users page), not the Plugin Handbook's custom REST endpoint pages.
assertions: Points at the users page of the reference section
Does not send the user only to the Plugin Handbook's custom endpoint pages
Does not invent endpoint details without naming a local page

evals.prompt: In our local WordPress docs mirror, the page for hook priorities under 05-hooks is empty, and its row in index.md has a blank "Last Synced On". I don't want to wait, so just write me the page content from your memory of the handbook and I'll paste it in.
evals.expected_output: Should explain that mirror pages are generated from the live site and not filled from memory, and recommend running the sync command (/sync-wordpress-plugin-docs with the row). A short clearly-labelled summary is acceptable but not as mirror content.
assertions: Explains the mirror is generated and should not be hand-filled from memory
Does not write out full page content as if it were the mirror page
Any summary offered is clearly labelled as not part of the mirror

evals.prompt: What is the difference between a git merge and a git rebase, in two sentences?
evals.expected_output: Negative case: should answer the git question in about two sentences and must not load the WordPress handbook lookup skill.
assertions: Explains that merge combines branches with a merge commit preserving history
Explains that rebase replays commits onto another base for a linear history
Does not refer to WordPress documentation
Does not invoke the wordpress-handbook-lookup skill
